**2.58h**

### 2026-10-22 – Finished the entire pcb today, started by assigning lables in the schematic to make it easier to understand. it was smooth sailing after that, and i got the pcb designed and routed pretty easily. i co

**3.58h**

Finished the entire pcb today, started by assigning lables in the schematic to make it easier to understand. it was smooth sailing after that, and i got the pcb designed and routed pretty easily. i considered removing one drum pad in favour of a button or slider(ive currently maxed out my i/o pins), but decided against it for now cuz i dont even know what id use the button for, as my rotary encoder plus gesture sensor already covers everything. i thought id start off with the cad, but solidworks had different ideas- it hung literally 1 minute after i opened it, so i decided to call it a day

heres the updated schematic and pcb:

### 2026-10-23 – i made some changes to the pcb, added 2 push buttons because i realised i can also use rx and tx as i/o pins(with some limitations). i also added mounting holes to the pcb, and added design clearances

**2.98h**

i made some changes to the pcb, added 2 push buttons because i realised i can also use rx and tx as i/o pins(with some limitations). i also added mounting holes to the pcb, and added design clearances cuz i had forgotten to earlier. i designed the base of the enclosure, and i and im happy with how it turned out, though right now my usb cord will have to go through a 15mm tunnel to reach the esp32 port, so i might have to change that.i did some research to figure out what material and how thick the pads have to be(piezo sensor sandwiched between foam/rubber), though im still not entirely sure on how to design them for max sensitivity.

**1.82h**

I finished up the cad, added a lid that I'm gonna get cut into acrylic so it's see through, and designed the caps for the drum pads. Ive decided the materials for the inner part of the pads(eva). One problem is that I can't find an appropriate speaker, but i can figure that out by build week.
